title: Hardware Test Engineer - Electronics
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Hardware Test Engineer for Electronics, you will be deeply involved in the electrical testing of hardware components and systems. Your expertise will be essential in executing a variety of electrical tests, from component-level analysis to system-wide functionality checks, ensuring all electronic products meet technical specifications and performance criteria.

Responsibilities

  • Design and conduct electrical tests such as signal integrity, power loading, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) using oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and network analyzers.
  • Implement embedded firmware for microcontrollers to simulate operational conditions for electronic testing.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot circuitry issues using multimeters, logic analyzers, and in-circuit emulators.
  • Collaborate with design engineers to refine PCB layouts and circuit designs based on test findings.
  • Document all test results and develop reports that outline findings, conclusions, and recommendations for improvements.
  • Stay current with advancements in electronic testing equipment and techniques.
  • Adhere to and enforce compliance with electronic safety standards and regulations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience with hands-on electronic hardware testing and debugging.
  • Strong proficiency with electronic test equipment and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of printed circuit board (PCB) design and testing, including familiarity with EDA tools like KiCad or Altium Designer.
  • Solid understanding of digital and analog circuitry, as well as experience with power electronics.
  • Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics and datasheets.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with RF testing and wireless communications standards.
  • Involvement in open-source hardware projects or community electronics groups.
  • Fluent in English.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

Enfermeiro(a) Supervisor Hemodiálise

The Service Level Manager (SLM) is responsible for ensuring that all IT services meet the agreed-upon service levels and performance standards. This role involves managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs), supervising service performance, and working closely with both internal teams and external vendors to ensure high-quality service delivery. The SLM will play a crucial role in aligning IT services with business objectives and customer expectations.
The position requires strong alignment with ITIL best practices, COBIT governance principles, and industry performance benchmarks. The SLM is also a key agent in driving continuous improvement, digital transformation, and the innovation of user-centric services.
Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

  • Develop, negotiate, and handle SLAs with internal and external partners and supervise and report on service performance against SLAs.
  • Conduct regular reviews of SLAs to ensure they remain relevant and aligned with business needs.
  • Maintain a centralized and accessible Service Catalogue and being responsible for ITSM governance, for example, incident, change, problem and transition management.
  • Use data-driven insights to predict and prevent potential service disruptions and analyze service performance and structured root cause analysis data to identify trends and areas for improvement.

  • Lead initiatives to improve service delivery processes and enhance customer satisfaction and promote user-centric innovation and stay updated with industry standard methodologies and emerging trends in IT service management.

We have the opportunity for you!

We are seeking an ICQA Area Manager to join our Fulfilment Center's Inventory Control and Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. Our Fulfilment Centers lie at the core of Amazon’s rapidly expanding operations network: they are where we handle our highly dynamic inventory. In every Fulfilment Center, our teams receive deliveries, pick products, package them, and ship them out. Each team contributes to our success, and you can be a key player in driving us forward.

These Fulfilment Centers are fast-paced, high-impact, and highly rewarding environments, where adherence to policies and procedures is critical. We are looking for an inspiring and capable leader to ensure we continue delivering on our customer promise while enabling our teams to excel with a customer-obsessed mindset.

Job responsibilities
As an ICQA Area Manager, you will:

  1. Lead and supervise a team of hourly associates in Inventory Control/Quality Assurance operations within the Fulfilment Center.
  2. Champion safety initiatives and ensure full compliance to maintain a safe and secure work environment for all associates.
  3. Coordinate inventory control maintenance and random counts aligned with network strategies, ensuring SOX compliance and consistency.
  4. Measure quality, inventory integrity, and accuracy, delivering actionable feedback to the operations management team.
  5. Conduct shift planning and forecasting while effectively assigning and directing work.
  6. Identify root causes of inventory deviations using cause-and-effect methodologies and implement corrective actions.
  7. Drive and support network-wide Fulfilment & Operations-focused quality initiatives.
  8. Review and analyze customer complaints and process defect data, developing comprehensive action plans to minimize future occurrences.
  9. Promote process improvements while developing your team’s capabilities to keep pace with our rapid growth, fostering a culture of excellence and engagement.
  10. Appraise team performance, providing tailored development, recognition, and coaching to unlock their full potential.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional qualification;
  2. Strong proficiency in time management skills, coupled with confidence in analyzing and organizing large datasets;
  3. Resilient, goal-oriented problem solver and self-starter, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively and prioritize in a dynamic and sometimes ambiguous environment;
  4. Proven ability to influence stakeholders across various seniority levels within an organization;
  5. Previous experience in inventory management, placement, and optimization strategies;
  6. Proficient in using the full MS Office suite, with advanced Excel skills; experience with MS Access is an advantage;
  7. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

As a Technical Producer focused on the Fortnite Ecosystem Multi-Product, you will partner with cross-disciplinary team members to develop features that expand Fortnite’s front-end, multi-game systems, and build upon our metaverse vision. You will be responsible for handling and organizing processes so that developers can do what they do best. You excel in organization, have exceptional communication abilities, and are comfortable managing complex projects. The ideal candidates are passionate about game technology and have a history of working within technical and distributed environments.

In this role, you will

  • Lead roadmap planning activities for your initiatives, including feedback collection, requirements gathering, initiative build-out, feature breakdown, estimations, and resourcing to drive a solid roadmap that achieves defined strategic product goals
  • Partner with discipline leads to determine the time and people necessary to see projects through to completion. Build and maintain project plans, schedules, resource allocation, and roadmaps, considering dependencies across multiple development teams to ensure successful releases
  • Provide transparent communications on project status and risks to stakeholders to ensure they are properly informed of any impacts from upcoming releases
  • Partner with multiple leaders to understand and balance priorities, requirements, and critical timelines
  • Collaborate with producers and other disciplines on the development teams needed to complete initiatives, communicate frequently, and proactively highlight progress, risks, and mitigations
  • Manage both internal and external resources as they pertain to resource allocation, budget forecasts, and actuals
  • Improve and develop processes based on the needs of the teams, initiatives, and products

What we're looking for

  • Experience in AAA games or game platforms from concept to release
  • Previous experience working in a production role where you've managed cross-functional teams in creating and delivering complex projects
  • Deep understanding of game or platform development, software development process, and project management practices
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • A good knowledge of light-touch production systems that allow teams to thrive without unnecessary overhead
  • Have the ability to communicate with varying levels of stakeholders within your team and throughout the company
  • A passion for gaming

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

title: Occupational Health & Safety Technician (Mid-Level)
description:
Occupational Health & Safety Technician (Mid-Level)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

ERM is seeking an Occupational Health & Safety Technician (Entry Level) to join our consultancy team in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
At ERM, we know that creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.
Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular inspections to detect, identify, and assess occupational risks across client Argentina locations.
  • Prepare technical reports with recommendations and corrective measures to promote a safe and healthy work environment.
  • Collaborate in developing and monitoring client Argentina’s Health and Safety Service procedures manual, including the Annual Risk Prevention Program.
  • Deliver mandatory safety and hygiene training sessions for client employees and document employee certifications.
  • Perform environmental monitoring (e.g., noise levels, lighting, ventilation) and recommend corrective measures where necessary.
  • Supervise ergonomic conditions and recommend improvements for injury prevention.
  • Ensure compliance with Argentine health and safety legislation, including Law No. 19,587, Law No. 24,557, and applicable SRT resolutions.
Requirements:
  • Certified Occupational Health & Safety Technician as per Decree 1338/96 requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of national occupational safety regulations (e.g., Law No. 19,587, Law No. 24,557) and familiarity with international standards (ISO 45001, NFPA 101) is preferred.
  • Ability to work across multiple locations in Buenos Aires and effective communication skills in both Spanish and English.
  • This position offers the opportunity to support critical occupational health and safety initiatives, directly contributing to creating a safer work environment for all ERM and client employees.
Background:
Since establishing our first local presence in the LAC region in 1990’s, ERM has enjoyed steady growth and today we employee circa 800 employees in the region. We have offices in Argentina, Peru, Colombia, Mexico, Guyana, and Brazil.
We are committed to the LAC market, and we have been building consulting teams with world-class skills in the areas of environmental, sustainability and social consulting for over 20 years. ERM has a solid client base in the oil and gas, manufacturing and chemical sectors and we have been collaborating very closely with our clients, supporting them through challenging times, as we remain committed to this fascinating sector. Increasingly our clients are investing in the local market and to support their growth needs, ERM is expanding our footprint in this region. We are now looking for a strong client and market leader who shares our passion and commitment to this sector to join us.
Who We Are:
 As the largest global pure play sustainability consultancy, we partner with the world’s leading organizations, creating innovative solutions to sustainability challenges, and unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations.
We also see our diversity as a strength that helps us create better solutions for our clients. Our diverse team of world-class experts supports clients across the breadth of their organizations to operationalize sustainability, underpinned by our deep technical expertise in addressing their environmental, health, safety, risk, and social issues. We call this capability our “boots to boardroom” approach for its comprehensive service model that allows ERM to develop strategic and technical solutions that advance objectives on the ground or at the executive level.
If you would like to read more about Diversity, Equity, Equality & Inclusion (DE&I) at ERM, you can visit our website , or read about our progress in the 2024 Sustainability Report .

O Grupo Sécheron Hasler continua a tradição suíça de mais de 140 anos no domínio da tecnologia ferroviária. Para a nossa unidade em São Paulo, estamos atualmente à procura de um Field Service Technician para reforçar a nossa equipa no Brasil. O Field Service Technician irá trabalhar cerca de 40% do tempo em campo em São Paulo, e cerca de 30% do tempo fora de São Paulo, podendo ser no Brasil ou no estrangeiro.
Como Field Service Technician, estas serão as suas responsabilidades:
Atendimento Ao Cliente

  • Garantir o desempenho eficiente dos serviços prestados aos nossos clientes no Brasil (ou no estrangeiro, se solicitado);
  • Fornecer as atividades de campo quando solicitado: supervisão de instalação, testes, comissionamento e treinamentos;
  • Executar as intervenções de emergência no local;
  • Efetuar reparações no local ou nas instalações da Sécheron;
  • Executar os trabalhos de manutenção;
  • Elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
Suporte a Vendas e Execução De Contratos
  • Apoio ao Engenheiro de Vendas em levantamentos de subestações e permissões de acesso ao local;
  • Realizar orçamentos de reparações;
  • Estar atento para identificar novas oportunidades de negócios: venda de peças de reposição, reparos, serviços on-site, modernizações, retrofits, treinamentos, contratos de manutenção, etc.
Logística e Stock
  • Apoio na gestão de stocks
  • Receção de mercadorias: Inspecionar a mercadoria após o processo de importação e identificar se a mesma segue de acordo com o pedido do cliente, informar o número de série dos itens, embalar o material e solicitar emissão de nota fiscal e transporte.
Requirements
Requisitos:
  • Experiência em instalação, teste e comissionamento de equipamento elétrico. Idealmente com experiência em manutenção e experiência em subestações de tração de corrente contínua.
  • Ativo, dinâmico, boa organização de tarefas e planeamento.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autónoma e em equipa.
  • Grau técnico ou bacharelato em: Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Industrial ou Engenharia Mecânica
  • Disponibilidade para viajar no Brasil ou no exterior (70%).
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês é necessária, qualquer outra língua adicional seria bom ter (Francês, Alemão, Espanhol)
Benefits
O que oferecemos:
Temos hierarquias planas e incentivamos a comunicação direta entre departamentos e níveis de gestão. Isto permite-nos tomar decisões rapidamente.
Damos aos nossos funcionários total responsabilidade pelas suas tarefas de trabalho. Encorajamos todos os funcionários a tomarem iniciativas e a contribuírem para a excelência operacional da empresa e damos-lhes amplas oportunidades para atingirem os seus objectivos de crescimento pessoal e profissional.

title: Social Network Engineer (AI Engineer)
description:
We’re not here to waste your time. Read this carefully and only apply if you’re ready to do real work that matters.


What the job entails:
  • You’ll be part of a team that will design and implement the backend and intelligence layer of our AI-managed merchant network. This isn’t a forum plugin or a skin on top of a chat app.
  • We’re designing a social fabric from scratch: matching merchants based on complementary offerings, shared pain points, and potential collaborations, then giving them the tools to grow together.
Your main tasks:
  • Architect and build a system to ingest merchant data (business category, geography, scale, needs).
  • Create agent-driven match-making and recommendation pipelines.
  • Develop moderation agents that guide discussions, keep quality high, and eliminate noise or abuse.
  • Integrate LLMs to facilitate onboarding, message summarization, semantic clustering, and auto-responses.
  • Build and evolve internal protocols for autonomous agent behavior, governance, and feedback loops.
  • Collaborate with frontend teams to create seamless user interactions with underlying intelligence.
  • Ship prototypes quickly, iterate based on feedback, and move toward scalable systems.
Technologies / techniques used:
  • Python (mandatory)
  • LLM ecosystems (OpenAI, Anthropic, open models)
  • LangChain, LangGraph or custom orchestration frameworks
  • Vector databases (Weaviate, Pinecone, PGVector)
  • NLP and recommendation techniques (semantic search, user embeddings, graph-based recs)
  • Moderation tooling (toxicity filters, content classifiers)
  • GCP (preferred), Docker, CI/CD pipelines
What you'll do:
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable artificial inteligence infrastructure.
  • Deploy and monitor AI systems for real-time inference.
  • Develop and maintain robust REST APIs for our AI services.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested production code.
  • Optimize and improve the performance of our AI systems.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies and best practices in machine learning and AIOps.
What you'll need:
  • Experience building real-time or asynchronous communication systems.
  • Strong Python engineering skills and ability to deploy scalable services.
  • Experience integrating LLMs into production environments.
  • Understanding of graph-based systems, user recommendation, or matchmaking logic.
  • Comfort building autonomous agents that act with minimal oversight.
  • Portuguese and English fluency. This system will handle data from and interact with Brazilian merchants daily.
  • Solid collaboration and product instincts. You can shape from zero with ambiguous specs.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with social network dynamics, either through product work or research.
  • Familiarity with community moderation tools, filters, or governance frameworks.
  • Prior work on user embeddings or behavior-based clustering.
  • Full-stack experience – you won’t build UI, but understanding it helps.
  • Previous experience or openness to learn Elixir
Recruiting process outline:
  • Technical case – explore a dataset of merchants and propose an intelligent recommendation approach.
  • Interview – discuss architecture, agent design, and AI deployment experience.
  • Cultural interview – alignment on autonomy, speed, and expectations.
  • If you are not willing to work on a test case, do not apply.

Diversity and inclusion:

We believe in social inclusion, respect, and appreciation of all people. We promote a welcoming work environment, where each CloudWalker can be authentic, regardless of gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexuality, mobility, disability, or education.

description:

6 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Nuclear Pharmacist role at Cardinal Health

What Nuclear Pharmacy Contributes To Cardinal Health
Pharmacy Operations is responsible for the safe, efficient and effective coordination of Cardinal Health's pharmacy operations that service acute care hospitals, hospital retail customers, ambulatory care and alternate site facilities, oncology and cardiology practices as well as retail customers.
Nuclear Pharmacy is responsible for providing radiopharmaceuticals and other drugs to medical care providers under highly regulated State and Federal guidelines; may also consult with or advise physicians and nuclear medicine technologists on the safe and efficacious use of radioactive drugs for diagnosis and therapy. Licensed.
Job Summary
PHARMACY ONLY
Through effective leadership and coordination with a team of direct reports, the primary purpose of the Pharmacist II, Nuclear is to manage, facilitate, and oversee execution of day-to-day operations of the nuclear pharmacy. The Pharmacist II, Nuclear has completed all necessary training and is licensed to be a practicing nuclear pharmacist in their state of occupation. As such, this job has responsibility for optimizing pharmacy operations and procedures to ensure consistent and efficient delivery to control costs, minimize waste, maximize customer satisfaction and deliver positive patient outcomes while maintaining compliance with Federal and state regulatory agencies. In addition, this job has responsibility for managing inventory, processing orders, compounding patient-specific doses of drugs and directing a team of drivers to deliver medications after they have been tested for quality.
Schedule

  • 40 hours
  • Rotating night shift every 3rd to 4th week. Typically 1:30 am and 9:30 am.
  • Day shift is typically is 7:30 am to 3:30 pm.
  • Will work weekend and on call rotation every 3rd to 4th week.
  • Will work holiday rotation as assigned
  • Candidate must be flexible to work different days, schedules, hours, come in early, stay late, or work overtime based on business needs.
Accountabilities
  • Provides pharmaceutical care to patients as a staff pharmacist, including compounding of nuclear medications, testing for quality through chromatography, and directing distribution of medication using a team of drivers.
  • Assesses and maintains pharmacy inventory and executes necessary orders, including reviews, to maintain optimal supply and ongoing availability of drugs, identifying and procuring alternative drugs to mitigate risks, when necessary.
  • Manages and directs internal workflows of nuclear pharmacy, including optimization of staffing and scheduling to maintain best-in-class and streamlined pharmacy operations.
  • Assists in execution of plans for lowering costs, increasing efficiency and driving profitable growth to support strategic business objectives in the nuclear pharmacy business.
  • Maintains relationships with outside suppliers and vendors to understand availability of drug components and assist in demand planning.
  • Participates in administrative tasks to facilitate nuclear pharmacy operations, including interactions with customers.
  • May oversee running of the facility (known as Pharmacist in Charge) if needed
  • Performs other job-related duties as required to ensure the goals and objectives of the department are met including delivering doses if necessary.
  • May assist with pharmacist duties in other states to provide staffing coverage in neighboring pharmacies
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy or PharmD
  • Valid Pharmacist’s license in the state in which the pharmacy operates, or is in the process of obtaining a valid license
  • Ability to get pharmacist license in other states for central fill needs and staffing purposes
  • Must complete at least 200 hours of academic training in a nuclear pharmacy through an accredited program
  • Working knowledge of biohazardous waste management procedures
  • Ability to hear, write, and speak clearly in order to communicate with customers and health care professionals
  • Strong customer service skills
  • Manual dexterity required for occasional reach, lifting and holding of small objects
  • Demonstrated manual dexterity in order to dispense doses
  • Manage weight up to 65 pounds
  • Willingness to travel if needed
  • Must hold a valid driver's license in the state in which the pharmacy is located or obtain one upon hire
  • Comfortable driving in all types of weather conditions (rain, sleet, snow, fog, wind and sun)
  • Deliveries occur during both nighttime and daytime conditions
  • Flexibility to work various shifts or overtime as needed
  • Intermediate computer skills (ability to use computers and tablets)
  • Ability to work weekends or be in a weekend rotation
  • Ability to work on call or be in an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work holidays or be in a holiday rotation
  • Prior Authorized User certification is preferred. Nuclear Pharmacy Training can be provided
What is expected of you and others at this level
  • Applies working knowledge in the application of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to perform varied tasks
  • Works on projects of moderate scope and complexity
  • Identifies possible solutions to a variety of technical problems and takes actions to resolve
  • Applies judgment within defined parameters
  • Receives general guidance may receive more detailed instruction on new projects
  • Work reviewed for sound reasoning and accuracy

description:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Associate Sales Operations Analysts to support a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be collaborative and demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be detail oriented problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales teams, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will support the delivery of programs to enable Canonical's continued success.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
The role entails:

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Check opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Analysts and Manager to report on and improve sales data quality and processes
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Assist the team with automation and streamlining of the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you:
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience working in an entry-level role in sales operations or related (e.g. financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing), preferably in the technology industry
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and communicate effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Solutions Architect for Automotive
description:
8 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Solutions Architect for Automotive to help our partners (companies like Mercedes, Ford, GM, Elektrobit, Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) and prospects understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to embedded. And we continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
Beyond an expected Automotive expertise, this career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also dedicated team players that take pride in team and company wins.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • Engage customers during presales to gather requirements and explain our technology
  • Liaise with other Canonical's experts (mastering the Cloud, Kubernetes, Security or Safety, etc) to aggregate our collective knowledge into comprehensive solutions for our prospective clients
  • Participate to the delivery of select projects related to Embedded Linux, including demos and PoCs
  • Convey market requirements to key stakeholders in our organization, and sometimes participate to the development or refining of generic solutions to unlock market potential
  • Be both a customer advocate and a trusted advisor to Canonical
If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies applied to Automotive, if you want to play an active role in building Software Defined Vehicles, if you are curious with a will to learn how to leverage and adapt Cloud technologies to the embedded world, you will love working at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Solid embedded Linux experience - Yocto or RTOS
  • Fluency in Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English in addition to the local language
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Result-oriented, ability to multi-task
  • A personal drive to meet commitments
  • An humble learner and quick study
  • Relevant experience in the Automotive industry
  • Albeit many projects can be done remotely, the successful candidate will be willing to travel up to 30% of the time for customer meetings, company events, and conferences
Additional skills that you might also bring (but not mandatory)
  • Experience with ISO26262 and/or ISO21434
  • Experience with customer engagements
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Technology Systems and Operations Specialist
description:
Technology Systems and Operations Specialist

Join to apply for the Technology Systems and Operations Specialist role at Netflix

Technology Systems and Operations Specialist

Join to apply for the Technology Systems and Operations Specialist role at Netflix

Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
About The Role.
As a team, we champion the end user to drive their success through technology. We simplify the complex. As a Learning Engine for Netflix, the Netflix Technology team (N-Tech) will seek out the friction users experience with technology and convert user friction into the fuel that drives effortless technology experiences.
As a Technology Systems and Operations Specialist (TSOS) for Netflix, you will be part of a global team ensuring an exceptional experience for Netflix’s 10,000+ users. Your top priorities will be managing technical issues, research, documentation, business-to-business relationships, and analyzing trends and the impact of these issues with the ultimate goal of driving improvements in Netflix facilities and overall user experience.
The N-Tech Technology Systems and Operations Specialist will operate as a technical leader for escalations, collaborating with internal and external teams to design systems and workflows that enable long-term operational success. Therefore, they must have a working knowledge of current digital technology trends and business needs as well as best practices both within and outside of the entertainment industry.
This position will partner with our frontline Netflix Technology Support, AV, and networking teams, as well as others, as we operate as an escalation point for various applications, services, and technologies. You’ll be responsible for reducing complexity and improving the user experience at Netflix-owned at Netflix-owned and operated properties by driving innovation, anticipating future needs, and aligning solutions to broader business goals.
Responsabilities.

  • Own the onsite experience for assigned Netflix Facilities.
  • Drive innovative end-user experience by piloting new technology and including workflow design that meets the business outcomes of our N-Tech organizations and meets our stakeholders' needs.
  • Develop strategic roadmaps that influence end-user experiences, ensuring alignment with business outcomes across the N-Tech organization.
  • Make autonomous decisions on operational challenges, utilizing data to anticipate future impacts and proactively addressing potential issues.
  • Partners cross-functionally with Stakeholders and Leadership (including, but not limited to, Networking Teams, Enterprise Operations, Employee Services, Content teams , etc.) to guide long-term improvements and lead high-impact initiatives.
  • Lead the day-to-day operation of Netflix facilities, Netflix-owned tools, and services, which include:
  • Develop Standard Operating Procedures and communicate changes to User-Experience and Engineering teams.
  • Leading and mentoring a team of Managed Service Providers (MSPs) or contractors to conduct work on behalf of Netflix. Ensures the quality of support through continuous review, feedback, and coaching
  • Create and leverage metrics and reporting to identify trends within the environment and collaborate effectively with partner teams to build value added and scalable solutions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve the end-user experience while reducing support volume and complexity through strategic improvements.
  • Serve as the escalation point for N-Tech teams and high-priority issues to ensure proper and timely resolution.
  • Analyze and curate actionable insights from escalations by creating and maintaining detailed root cause analysis reports, identifying workflows inefficiencies or systems gaps to mitigate recurrence.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts and coordinate escalations to engineering and technical teams, along with PjM and Workforce Productivity specialists ensuring seamless communication and resolution of complex challenges.
  • Oversee and drive incident resolution to closure, ensuring timely outcomes while capturing learnings to improve processes and systems organization-wide.
  • Develop Quality Assurance processes and runbook documentation that empowers our Stakeholders with self-service capabilities and enable support teams to efficiently troubleshoot, resolve, and escalate issues.
  • Right-fitting the work as needed ensures that all N-Tech partners and Stakeholders participate at the right time.
  • Regularly engage in business reviews with stakeholders to assess the effectiveness of these processes, gather feedback, and refine strategies to better meet stakeholder needs and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Blend deep knowledge of how users experience products with qualitative and quantitative data in order to help our Workforce Productivity Specialist (WPS) reduce friction and complexity in the end-to-end user experience.
  • Craft compelling, data-driven narratives around how users experience friction with technology, with the goal of influencing Product, Eng and partners to reduce complexity and improve productivity.
  • Provide advanced escalated support for complex issues that cannot be solved by N-Tech User Experience (NTE) and Domain/SME Specialists (i.e. support that requires additional knowledge of user workflow, deeper subject matter expertise, etc).
  • Designing the most optimal and scalable service path to ensure that N-Tech scales (ie determine what work goes back to Product etc).
  • Responsible for collaborating and advocating on memos created by Domain/SME Specialists and N-Tech Reliability Specialists.
Necessary Skills & Experience.
  • Business-level fluency in speaking and writing English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking, technically and business-wise, with the ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Solid understanding of Network infrastructure with the intent of a smart hands approach; routing & switching, DHCP servers, subnetting, & low voltage cabling.
  • Expertise in troubleshooting MacOS/Windows, Saas Applications, and AV systems.
  • Proven ability to quickly learn new technologies and with minimal guidance.
  • Familiarity with asset tracking, management, and deployment.
  • Local/Regional knowledge (vendors, general operation standards, culture, etc).
  • Effectively overseeing and improving the delivery of different services
  • Thrives on technical challenges and takes pride in solving them
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills both written and verbal.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently with minimal supervision; with a proven ability to initiate and execute ideas amidst ambiguity.
  • Technical depth and ability to analyze support data to identify trends to drive insight and overall product and operational improvement.
  • Ability to act as the informed captain and lead new initiatives concerning workflows and support.
  • Flexible amid an ever-changing and growing environment.
  • Information tracking, as it pertains to ancillary charges and overhead budgets
  • Capable of composing clear process and procedure documentation on complex topics

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. Opportunities are available in these preferred locations: Austin, Ann Arbor, Boise, Bismark, Billings, Charlotte, Chicago, Denver, Irvine, Fort Worth, Houston, Honolulu, Kansas City, Madison, Minneapolis, Missoula, Omaha, Phoenix, Portland (OR & ME), Richmond, Raleigh Sacramento/Folsom, San Diego, Seattle, Spokane, St Louis, Syracuse.
Primary Responsibilities
You will be part of a rapidly growing team wanting to take your career to the next level. Having developed foundational expertise in high voltage substation design, including physical and protection & controls design, you will be ready to undertake a more complex and responsible role requiring you to work independently while at times, directing, mentoring, training, and/or supervising less-experienced EITs and/or Designers.
As a Substation Project Engineer, your role will encompass the following:

  • Support preparing scopes, schedules, and budgets, and ensure that schedules and budgets are met
  • Understands physical substation design including yard layouts, plans, sections and details, grounding, lightning protection, control building arrangements, interior and exterior raceways, auxiliary AC/DC power systems, and associated bills of material

  • Coordinate design activities with other departments (Civil/Structural, Networks, Transmission Line, etc.)
  • Effectively communicate and coordinate project activities with manager, clients, and others as needed
  • Works independently and may direct, mentor, train, and/or supervise efforts of less-experienced EIT's and/or Designers.

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in substation design.
  • Specific experience performing aspects associated with substation design, including: One Line Diagrams, General Arrangements, Sections, Grounding, Conduit Plans, Foundation Plans, Material Lists, Relay and Control Systems, Control Schematics, and Wiring Diagrams.
  • Strong computer skills Microsoft Office and electrical design software.
  • Some travel may be required.
  • Experience with substation design for 12kV thru 500kV desired, experience thru 765kV an added benefit.
  • Previous experience with an architectural/ engineering or engineering consulting firm desired.
,

Com a nova expansão das unidades de Móveis e Sinalização Viária, nos tornamos o maior parque fabril do país, com mais de 79 mil m².

A Sinalmig segue investindo em maquinário de última geração e tecnologia de ponta, mantendo constantemente seus colaboradores e prestadores de serviços com treinamentos atualizados, para atender com excelência e ofertar produtos de qualidade.

JEITO SINALMIG DE SER

MISSÃO: Projetar, fabricar, transportar e instalar elementos de comunicação visual, sinalização viária, mobiliário e portas, superando as expectativas dos nossos clientes de forma sustentável.

VISÃO: Ser referência internacional com forte presença na América Latina, diferenciando-se pela qualidade dos nossos produtos e serviços.

NEGÓCIO: Impulsionar o crescimento dos nossos clientes.

PROPÓSITO: Proporcionar segurança, visibilidade, conforto e crescimento aos nossos clientes.

VALORES SINALMIG

Foco no cliente: Orientar nossas energias para atender as expectativas dos clientes, tendo como premissas básicas a qualidade e os prazos das entregas.

Trabalho em Equipe: A união das habilidades, talentos e forças para produzir resultados. É imprescindível ter integração e dedicação de cada um, compartilhando e trocando ideias para alcançar os objetivos de metas em equipe.

description:
Job Title : Database Administrator (SQL Server, MySQL) with DevOps Experience

Employment Type : Full-Time (on-site)

Salary : Competitive and commensurate with experience

About Us

SmartEnergy is a forward-thinking organization dedicated to delivering innovative solutions in clean energy. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to solve complex challenges for our clients, fostering a culture of collaboration, growth, and innovation.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Database Administrator with expertise in SQL Server and MySQL, and experience in DevOps practices on AWS. This role is a blend of database management and DevOps responsibilities, designed for a professional who thrives in dynamic environments.

Key Responsibilities

Database Administration:

  1. Design, implement, and maintain SQL Server and MySQL databases to ensure high availability and performance.
  2. Manage database backups, replication, recovery, and failover strategies.
  3. Monitor database performance and perform tuning for optimization.
  4. Develop and maintain database security policies and procedures.
  5. Collaborate with development and data engineering teams to design and review database schemas and queries.

DevOps on AWS:

  1. Deploy and manage infrastructure using AWS services (e.g., EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, etc.).
  2. Implement CI/CD pipelines for database and application deployments.
  3. Monitor cloud infrastructure and databases using tools like CloudWatch, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  4. Automate routine tasks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.
  5. Manage version control and collaborate on DevOps workflows using Bitbucket.

Qualifications

Technical Skills:

  1. Proven experience as a Database Administrator with SQL Server and MySQL in production environments.
  2. Hands-on experience with AWS services, including RDS, EC2, S3, and IAM.
  3. Proficiency in DevOps practices, including CI/CD, automation, and containerization (Docker/ECS is a plus).
  4. Proficient in scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
  5. Familiarity with database tools like SSMS, MySQL Workbench, or equivalent.
  6. Understanding of database compliance and regulatory requirements.

Other Requirements:

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
  3. Strong communication and collaboration abilities.

What We Offer

  1. Competitive salary and benefits package.
  2. Opportunities for professional growth and certification support.
  3. A collaborative, innovative work culture.
  4. Flexible working arrangements, including remote work options.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a cover letter detailing relevant experience and achievements to Please include “Database Administrator with DevOps Experience” in the subject line.

Join to apply for the Associate Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Associate Sales Operations Analysts to support a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be collaborative and demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be detail oriented problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales teams, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will support the delivery of programs to enable Canonical's continued success.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
The role entails:

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Check opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Analysts and Manager to report on and improve sales data quality and processes
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Assist the team with automation and streamlining of the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you:
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience working in an entry-level role in sales operations or related (e.g. financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing), preferably in the technology industry
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and communicate effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Responsabilidades Da Posição

  • Operar mandriladora CNC de médio e grande porte, realizando o correto posicionamento e fixação das peças, regulagem da máquina e acionamento do ciclo de usinagem por meio do painel CNC (comandos Heidenhain e Fanuc).
  • Executar a programação e/ou ajustes diretamente no painel da máquina, interpretando os desenhos técnicos 2D e garantindo conformidade com as especificações de usinagem, tolerâncias e materiais.
  • Realizar a troca e ajuste de ferramentas de corte, como fresas, brocas, cabeçotes, entre outros, conforme necessidade da operação e características do material.

  • Registrar os apontamentos de produção em sistema informatizado, de acordo com a ordem de produção, incluindo tempo de execução, peças produzidas, paradas e demais informações operacionais.
  • Repor óleo lubrificante no reservatório da máquina sempre que necessário, assegurando o bom funcionamento e evitando desgaste prematuro dos componentes.
  • Realizar a limpeza periódica da máquina e do posto de trabalho, removendo resíduos, organizando ferramentas e mantendo o ambiente conforme os padrões de segurança e produtividade.
  • Retirar os cavacos gerados no processo de usinagem e transportar até o local específico de descarte, respeitando as normas ambientais e operacionais.
  • Zelar pela organização e conservação do ambiente de trabalho, mantendo bancadas, ferramentas e acessórios limpos, seguros e acessíveis.
  • Utilizar corretamente os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPI) e Equipamentos de Proteção Coletiva (EPC) fornecidos pela empresa, garantindo a própria segurança e a dos colegas.
  • Cumprir rigorosamente as normas internas de segurança do trabalho, saúde ocupacional e procedimentos operacionais, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho seguro e colaborativo.
Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição
  • Curso técnico na área de Usinagem;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência na função;
  • Domínio em programação de usinagem diretamente no painel da máquina (pé da máquina);
  • Experiência e domínio em comandos Heidenhain e Fanuc;
  • Experiência em usinagem de peças não seriadas;
  • Experiência e domínio em mandrilhadoras CNC de médio e grande porte;
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnico 2D;
  • Disponibilidade para turnos e contra turnos (2º turno).
Sobre a Empresa
Fundada em 1948, a empresa é referência global na fabricação de equipamentos para a indústria madeireira e no fornecimento de soluções para o processamento de resíduos e geração de biomassa. Com um parque fabril de aproximadamente 20.000 m², é reconhecida como uma das três maiores fabricantes mundiais de equipamentos para produção de lâminas de madeira e também como um dos principais produtores nacionais de picadores.
Com cerca de 150 colaboradores e presença consolidada em mais de 60 países , incluindo mercados exigentes como Estados Unidos, Chile e Rússia, a empresa vive um momento estratégico de reestruturação e crescimento, investindo na modernização de processos, no fortalecimento da cultura interna e na valorização das pessoas como pilares essenciais para o futuro.
Para Candidatos De Outras Cidades

title: Músico é indiciado por morte de adolescente em Teresina
description:
Músico é indiciado por morte de adolescente em Teresina

Músico teria fornecido carro usado no rapto e execução de Carlos Alexandre.

  • Carlos Alexandre, 14 anos, foi morto com tiro na cabeça em Teresina.
  • A investigação foi concluída pelo Departamento de Homicídios e Proteção à Pessoa (DHPP), que indiciou quatro suspeitos por homicídio e ligação com facção criminosa.

O músico Reginaldo Freitas foi indiciado por participação na morte do adolescente Carlos Alexandre . A informação foi confirmada nesta sexta-feira (25) pelo delegado Jorge Terceiro , do DHPP . Além dele, outros três suspeitos, incluindo um adolescente apreendido, também foram indiciados.

  • Quatro suspeitos foram indiciados: A Polícia Civil do Piauí, por meio do DHPP, concluiu o inquérito e indiciou quatro pessoas pelo crime. Três adultos foram presos e um adolescente apreendido. O processo foi encaminhado à Justiça.
  • Músico forneceu carro usado no crime: O veículo utilizado para o rapto e assassinato do garoto foi identificado como sendo de propriedade do músico Reginaldo Freitas. Ele chegou a ser detido durante as investigações e posteriormente liberado. Foi indiciado por homicídio qualificado, por fornecer os meios materiais para a execução.
  • Motivação envolve relação com facção: Segundo o delegado Jorge Terceiro, Carlos Alexandre não fazia parte de facção criminosa , mas tinha parentes ligados ao crime organizado , o que pode ter motivado o assassinato por retaliação ou recado entre grupos rivais .
  • Investigação finalizada e pedido de prisão preventiva: O inquérito foi concluído e enviado ao Judiciário , com o pedido de conversão das prisões temporárias em preventivas . A participação do menor infrator será investigada por uma unidade especializada da capital .

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Associate Sales Operations Analysts to support a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be collaborative and demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be detail oriented problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales teams, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will support the delivery of programs to enable Canonical's continued success.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
The role entails:

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Check opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Analysts and Manager to report on and improve sales data quality and processes
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Assist the team with automation and streamlining of the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you:
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience working in an entry-level role in sales operations or related (e.g. financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing), preferably in the technology industry
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and communicate effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Profile Summary and Description
We are seeking a data-savvy, highly analytical, and purpose-driven Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Data & Digital Manager to shape and lead the execution of our ESG data & digital strategy. This is a unique opportunity to drive meaningful impact — leveraging data to power decisions, ensuring transparency, and helping us meet our sustainability targets.

Job Description
Job Profile Summary and Description
We are seeking a data-savvy, highly analytical, and purpose-driven Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Data & Digital Manager to shape and lead the execution of our ESG data & digital strategy. This is a unique opportunity to drive meaningful impact — leveraging data to power decisions, ensuring transparency, and helping us meet our sustainability targets.
You will sit at the intersection of sustainability and cutting-edge data & analytics, acting as a crucial link between ESG expertise and technical execution. This role involves close collaboration with our digital (MDS) teams, third-party providers, and key functions to enable the delivery of our ESG solutions that are efficient, reliable, insightful, and integrated into business processes. Ultimately, you will play a critical role in transforming the way we collect, manage, analyze, and report trustworthy ESG data which underpins our targets and disclosures.
How You Will Contribute

  • Shape ESG Data Solutions: Partner with ESG subject matter experts to understand their data needs, identify opportunities for process and workflow improvements, and partner with the MDS team to drive design and implementation of data solutions with a focus on accuracy, completeness, and reliability;
  • Co-create ESG Data Roadmaps: Work hand-in-hand with our MDS team to develop comprehensive short-, medium-, and long-term ESG data roadmaps that are aligned with our overarching sustainability and ESG reporting strategies;
  • Manage ESG Data & Analytics Projects: Manage ESG data and analytics projects, driving strong stakeholder alignment, proactively identifying and mitigating risks, and ensuring projects are delivered successfully, on time and within budget;
  • Establish ESG Data Governance & Quality: Lead the establishment of robust data governance practices, including the development of data catalogues, establishment of data lineage, integration of data management tools, and monitoring data quality and resolving issues to uphold data accuracy and completeness;
  • Drive ESG Reporting & Insights: Lead the design and build of dashboards and forward-looking analytics tools that meet the evolving needs of business and reporting requirements;
  • Empower Business Users: Foster a data-driven culture by promoting self-service ESG data capabilities, equipping business users with the confidence and tools to independently access, explore, and use ESG data for their own analysis, reporting, and decision-making.

What You Will Bring
  • BACHELOR’S DEGREE in sustainability, environmental economics, environmental engineering, or related fields;
  • 8+ YEARS OF EXPERIENCE in sustainability data management, or similar roles;
  • PASSION for data, analytics, and dashboards;
  • UNDERSTANDING of enterprise data systems (e.g., SAP), databases (e.g., SQL), data management, and/or reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau);
  • STRONG project management skills, including the ability to plan, execute, and deliver results within specified timelines. Certification in Project Management is a plus;
  • KNOWLEDGE of key ESG reporting standards, frameworks, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SASB, CSRD, IFRS, etc.) is a plus;
  • EXCELLENT analytical skills, identifying key themes, trends and root causes;
  • PROVEN EXPERIENCE working across cross-functional teams;
  • ABILITY to influence diverse stakeholders, build relationships, and work collaboratively at all levels of the organization;
  • GROWTH & DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to identify strategic opportunities and leverage technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness;
  • HIGH STANDARDS of integrity, accountability, and sound judgement in all decisions.

Job description

Embora o carro tenha um papel fundamental na vida de muitas pessoas, só 25% da população da América Latina consegue ter acesso a ele. E foi por isso que a Kovi nasceu: para mudar essa estatística!

Acreditamos que todas as pessoas merecem ter a oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas e, em busca desse propósito, trabalhamos todos os dias para criar soluções de mobilidade acessíveis, flexíveis e simples.

Hoje, já oferecemos planos de aluguel no inédito modelo “pague o que usar”, compra de carros sem análise de crédito e seguro auto com contratação simplificada. E queremos continuar promovendo a inclusão, através da eficiência e inovação!

O desafio é grande, mas nossa vontade de fazer a diferença é ainda maior! E estamos buscando pessoas incríveis para fazer parte dessa revolução. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e de aprendizado constante. #VemSerKover!

Time Kovi:

Ser Kover é sinônimo de ser super engajado quando o assunto é desafio. Amamos pessoas que se importam com outras pessoas, que tenham brilho nos olhos e vontade de sobra para mudar o mundo. Se você acredita em um mundo onde todos tenham oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas, vem ser #Kover!


Main responsibilities

A equipe de Ops Strategy atua como braço direito do COO na condução da performance e crescimento da área. Lideramos o planejamento financeiro de todos os custos operacionais (COGS e SG&A), tocamos iniciativas estratégicas que envolvem múltiplas áreas e definimos como a tecnologia deve ser alavancada para gerar impacto real em frentes como Manutenção, Supply Chain e Procurement. Nossa missão é conectar a estratégia com a execução, garantindo que a operação escale de forma eficiente.

Como Especialista em Estratégia, você irá liderar de maneira independente frentes de trabalho com alto impacto. Criar modelos de controle e otimização de custos, encontrar marcas/modelos de carro oferecem os melhores resultados financeiros e definir nosso footprint ideal de plantas produtivas são alguns exemplos. É uma posição de grande autonomia e profunda colaboração que oferece a oportunidade de desenvolver sua visão de negócio, habilidade de construção e implantação de soluções estruturantes e capacidade analítica, ao lado de times experientes e das lideranças mais seniores da empresa.


Requirements and skills

  • Capacidade analítica sólida, em especial em modelagens matemáticas, estatísticas e financeiras
  • Perfil pragmático e orientado à ação, com habilidade para destravar problemas e manter stakeholders alinhados
  • Habilidade de estruturação e condução de resolução de problemas
  • Perfil hands-on e com interesse em aprender rápido temas desconhecidos
  • Facilidade para colaborar com diferentes áreas — Operações, Tecnologia, Finanças, CX, etc.
  • Bom conhecimento em Excel/Sheets; SQL é diferencial

Additional information

Seguro de Vida: Para cuidarmos do nosso bem maior: nossos Kovers.

Plano de Saúde: É importante se cuidar e estar bem.

Plano Odontológico: Para você dar aquele sorrisão bonito!

In doing so, you’ll join a talented and supportive Privacy Team and work closely with key stakeholders across the business, promoting a strong culture of handling and managing personal data sensitively and effectively.
With an increasing focus on adopting and developing AI, this role is also uniquely positioned to help build and shape Convatec’s Responsible AI Programme.
Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support our Americas Data Privacy Officer to deliver the Privacy Team’s global strategy in Americas, by being the primary point of contact for the LATAM businesses and by monitoring legal and regulatory developments across the region, and advising on necessary adaptions and improvements to Convatec’s Privacy Programme.
  • Serve as a Privacy expert for our Americas businesses and working closely with and advising businesses and clinical leaders, counsel, and other colleagues on all aspects of privacy, including performing Data Protection Impact Assessments, reviewing Data Protection Agreements/clauses, supporting supplier due diligence, marketing initiatives, embedding privacy by design into projects including IT projects, digital initiatives, responding to data subjects’ rights requests and data breaches.
  • Support the Americas Data Privacy Officer in maturing the regional Privacy Programme to develop, refine and simplify scalable, policies, processes, and systems to protect the patient, Health Care Professional, and employee data we process whilst enabling the business to fulfil its mission of creating pioneering heathcare.
  • Work with the wider Legal team to develop and strengthen precedents, playbooks and processes to streamline and supercharge the team.
  • Work collaboratively with key stakeholders, including LATAM Leadership teams and country managers, the Digital Solutions, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, HR and Information Security teams, advising on new projects, setting clear accountabilities and policies for data protection.
  • Develop and deliver engaging and helpful training and awareness programmes.
  • Monitor privacy and AI regulation and advise on required/desired adaptations and improvements to Convatec’s Privacy and Responsible AI Programmes.

Essential:

  • Skilled at collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders across all levels of the business
